title: 第18章男儿敢作敢当，剑斗罗的杀心-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    宁荣荣听到这道熟悉的怒喊声，表情微微一愣。

    但随即，她的小脸上便浮现出开心的笑容。

    是最疼爱她的剑爷爷来了。

    “剑爷爷，我在这！”

    宁荣荣高兴地跑了出去，向御剑飞行而来的剑斗罗招了招手。

    可是当她看到跟在剑斗罗身后的七宝琉璃宗宗主宁风致后，脸上的笑容瞬间消失了。

    她现在最不想看到的就是爸爸了。

    “荣儿，这段时间你受苦了啊。”

    “快让爷爷看看，你的伤好了没。”

    怒火中烧的剑斗罗看到宁荣荣，脸色突然变了，面带宠溺的笑容，将她搂入怀中，满脸心疼之色。

    宁荣荣在宁风致以及七宝琉璃宗弟子的眼中，是个就知道惹事任性的混世小魔女，可在剑斗罗和骨斗罗的眼中，那就是宝贝孙女啊。

    谁敢欺负宁荣荣，他就活剐了谁。

    这不，宁风致在收到匿名信时，被剑斗罗刚好撞见了。

    他看到信上的内容，便马不停蹄地向史莱克学院赶来。

    宁风致怕剑斗罗把事情闹大了，这才被迫无奈地跟着一起过来。

    对于匿名信上说的事，他虽然也感到气愤，但更多的却是疑问。

    他太了解自己闺女的性格了，除了惹事，还是惹事，丝毫不将任何人放在眼里。

    有时候，宁荣荣连他这个父亲也不放在眼里。

    否则就不可能出现离家出走这一幕。

    他感觉匿名信上的内容肯定有不为人知的秘密，极有可能有人想利用这件事，来针对这位叫叶寒的少年。

    要不然，以宁荣荣的性格，早就跑回来了，或者是写亲笔信派人送回去。

    所以，他要把这件事弄清楚。

    如果真有此事，他肯定会严肃处理。

    但若是有人在故意夸大其词，利用七宝琉璃宗报私仇，那就别怪他心狠了。

    “伤势？”

    “剑爷爷，我没受伤啊。”

    宁荣荣听到剑斗罗的关爱，一脸懵逼，不知道他在说什么。

    她还以为是宗门弟子找到了她在这里的行踪，这才来史莱克学院。

    此时，宁荣荣想到了刚才剑斗罗那句怒吼，好像是在说叶寒欺负她。

    这都是三天前的事情了，她也没有写信回家，剑爷爷是怎么知道的。

    “你怎么没受伤。”

    “信上不是说，你被一个叫叶寒的浑蛋扇了一巴掌，还被他威胁，不让你跟家里人联系吗？”

    “那小子在哪儿，看我不杀了他，将他千刀万剐。”

    剑斗罗从怀里掏出匿名信，递了过去。

    这时候，叶寒、赵无极、弗兰德、朱竹清、唐三和戴沐白等人都出来了。

    “是宁宗主和剑前辈来了啊，有失远迎。”

    “我是史莱克学院的院长弗兰德，这位是副院长赵无极。”

    “两位来此，是我们史莱克学院的荣幸。”

    弗兰德和赵无极都是混迹斗罗大陆的老江湖了，自然认识七宝琉璃宗宗主宁风致和长老剑斗罗，赶紧走了过来，笑脸迎接。

    七宝琉璃宗是斗罗大陆上三宗之一，实力雄厚，可不是他们能够得罪的。

    也不知道怎么回事，这几天咋这么倒霉啊。

    前几天刚被唐昊揍了一顿，现在倒好，七宝琉璃宗又找上门来了。

    看剑斗罗刚才那愤怒的样子，应该是来找叶寒的。

    这下有点麻烦了。

    “弗院长，赵院长，客气了。”

    “还不是我这个淘气的闺女，到处乱跑，给你们添麻烦了。”

    宁风致为人性格比较温和，面带微笑，向两人微微抱拳回礼。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Ning Rongrong heard this familiar angry shout, his expression was slightly startled.

But then, a happy smile appeared on her little face.

Grandpa Jian, who loves her the most, is here.

"Grandpa Jian, I'm here!"

Ning Rongrong happily ran out and waved to Sword Douluo, who was flying over with his sword.

But when she saw Ning Fengzhi, the leader of the Seven Treasures Glazed Sect, who was following Sword Douluo, the smile on her face disappeared instantly.

The last thing she wants to see now is her father.

"Rong'er, you have suffered a lot during this time."

"Let grandpa see if your injury is healed."

When the furious Sword Douluo saw Ning Rongrong, his expression suddenly changed. With a doting smile on his face, he hugged her into his arms with a look of distress on his face.

In the eyes of Ning Fengzhi and the disciples of the Qibao Glazed Sect, Ning Rongrong was a little witch who knew how to cause trouble, but in the eyes of Sword Douluo and Bone Douluo, she was a precious granddaughter.

Whoever dares to bully Ning Rongrong will be chopped alive by him.

No, when Ning Fengzhi received the anonymous letter, Sword Douluo happened to bump into him.

When he saw the contents of the letter, he rushed to Shrek Academy without stopping.

Ning Fengzhi was afraid that Sword Douluo would make things worse, so he was forced to follow him helplessly.

Although he was also angry about what was said in the anonymous letter, he was more doubtful.

He knows his daughter’s character too well. She will only cause trouble, and she won’t take anyone seriously at all.

Sometimes, Ning Rongrong doesn’t even pay attention to his father.

“Otherwise, the scene of running away from home would not have been possible.

He felt that there must be some unknown secret in the anonymous letter, and it was very likely that someone wanted to use this matter to target the young man named Ye Han.

要不然，以宁荣荣的性格，早就跑回来了，或者是写亲笔信派人送回去。

So, he wants to figure this out.

If this really happens, he will definitely deal with it seriously.

“But if someone is deliberately exaggerating and using the Qibao Glazed Sect to seek personal revenge, then don’t blame him for being cruel.

"Injury?"

"Grandpa Jian, I'm not injured."

Ning Rongrong was confused when he heard Sword Douluo's care and concern, not knowing what he was talking about.

She thought it was the disciples of the sect who found her whereabouts here, and that's why she came to Shrek Academy.

At this time, Ning Rongrong thought of Sword Douluo's roar just now, which seemed to be about Ye Han bullying her.

This happened three days ago, and she didn’t write a letter home. How did Grandpa Jian know about it.

"How come you weren't hurt?"

"Didn't the letter say that you were slapped by a jerk named Ye Han, and that he threatened you not to contact your family?"

"Where is that kid? Let me kill him or not. I will cut him into pieces with a thousand knives."

Sword Douluo took out the anonymous letter from his arms and handed it over.

At this time, Ye Han, Zhao Wuji, Flanders, Zhu Zhuqing, Tang San, Dai Mubai and others all came out.

"It's Sect Master Ning and Senior Jian who are here. They are waiting to be welcomed from afar."

“I am Flanders, the dean of Shrek Academy, and this is Zhao Wuji, the deputy dean.”

“It’s our Shrek Academy’s honor that you two are here.”

​​ Flender and Zhao Wuji are both old people who have been involved in the Douluo Continent. Naturally, they knew Ning Fengzhi, the master of the Seven Treasures Glazed Sect, and Elder Sword Douluo. They hurried over and greeted them with smiles.

The Qibao Glazed Sect is one of the three sects on the Douluo Continent. It is very powerful and cannot be offended by them.

I don’t know what’s going on. Why have I been so unlucky these past few days?

“I was beaten up by Tang Hao a few days ago, but now it’s good, the Qibao Glazed Sect came to visit me again.

Looking at Sword Douluo's angry look just now, he should have come to see Ye Han.

It’s a bit troublesome now.

"Dean Fu, Dean Zhao, you're welcome."

"It's not like I, a naughty girl, am running around and causing trouble for you."

Ning Fengzhi has a gentle personality, smiles on his face, and returns the favor with a slight cup of fist to the two of them.
